# Install and manage add-ons in Terraform Developer Portal

Terraform Developer Portal add-ons let application developers install supporting infrastructure, such as databases, storage buckets, or caches, at any point in an application's lifecycle. After you install an add-on, you can rename it, update it to a new module version, or uninstall it.

@include "beta/tdp.mdx"

## Prerequisites

- An HCP Terraform organization on the **Standard edition** or higher to use HCP Terraform no-code modules and the private module registry. Refer to [HCP Terraform pricing](https://www.hashicorp.com/products/terraform/pricing) for plan details.
- An account in your HCP Terraform organization with permission to create workspaces.
- A Terraform Developer Portal add-on definition to deploy. Refer to [Create and manage add-on definitions](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/addon-create) for more information.

## Install an add-on

To install an add-on in an application, complete the following steps: 

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to install the add-on. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on your application. 
1. Click **Available add-ons** in the application sidebar. 
1. Select the add-on to install. Click **Install** or **Install another**.

Terraform Developer Portal creates a new workspace for each installed add-on in the same project as the application you are installing it in. You can install multiple instances of each add-on.

## Rename an installed add-on

To rename an installed add-on, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to edit the installed add-on. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the installed add-on you want to edit.
1. Click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel.
1. Click the name of the add-on you want to rename.
1. Click the **Manage** dropdown, then choose **Rename**.
1. In the **Add-on Name** field, enter the desired name for your installed add-on.
1. Click **Save**.


## Update an installed add-on

When you update the version of a no-code module that an add-on definition uses, each installed add-on displays an update notification. HCP Terraform does not update add-ons automatically. The add-on owner must respond to the notification. HCP Terraform prompts for values for any new input variables. Refer to [Design no-code ready modules](/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/no-code-provisioning/module-design#updating-a-module-s-version) for more information.

If the new module version adds an input variable, update the add-on settings first. Provide a default value or allow the application developer to supply a value when installing the add-on.

To update an installed add-on, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to update the installed add-on.
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the installed add-on you want to edit.
1. Click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel, then click the name of the add-on you want to update.
1. Click **View update**. 
1. Enter values for any new input variables. 
1. Click **Save configuration & start plan**. 
1. Click **Go to run details**. 
1. Review the plan output, then click **Confirm & apply** to apply the update. 

When you apply the update, Terraform Developer Portal automatically starts a plan run in HCP Terraform. If the plan completes successfully, HCP Terraform automatically starts an apply run to update the workspace. 

## Uninstall an add-on

Uninstalling an add-on deletes its HCP Terraform workspace and the resources it manages.

To uninstall an add-on, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to delete the installed add-on. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the application with the installed add-on you want to delete.
1. Click **Installed add-ons** in the left navigation panel.
1. Click the ellipsis (**...**) button next to the add-on you want to remove, then click **Uninstall**.
1. Enter "UNINSTALL" in the **Uninstall add-on?** dialog, then click **Uninstall**.
